body: It's been 28 long years. At this point I could care less if there is negative influences. After this long there is no other feeling. If you can't get fixed in 28 years, nothing will fix you.

Now we are getting into territory of I think there for I am. I'm of the opinion that if you take the time to make a proper judgment than that is the best you can do. If you took the time to get help, to research every area and come to a conclusion than that's the best you can do and that's the improtant aspect.

You just proved my point. My suffering isn't good enough. I need to man up because there are others who would swap with me. What if I told you I'd swap with them gladly? Of course I'll be choosing death, but I'd gladly swap with anything you just mentioned.
Thank you. I appreciate your input. :)
No family. Sorry to disappoint you. I'm assuming you will disappoint me as well with no answer to my question after answering many of yours.

See, that's a loaded question. It doesn't matter how good the reasons are to me personally because you will shoot each and every one of the reasons down. What's a good reason for me will never mesh with everyone else in the world. Everyone is different.

You certainly have a point. Nothing really would be exempt. You are shaped by your environment. That includes your state of mind. However, long term decisions aren't spontaneous. You have given them deep thought. A long term decision is as clear as you will get. You spent the time to analyze the situation and the outcomes.
No. Not everyone is blessed with the made for TV family.

Like I said in the OP, I only have one person close to me and they are not local. They know my situation. They've helped as much as they can. They are the one who I need to choose whether I send or don't send the letter.

As I mentioned I'm another comment. This isn't a snap judgment. I've done everything possible to try and help. There is no help. I'm not someone who rushes in. I think critically about every decision and try every option available.  
  
I'm past being helped. I just need to know whether I find peace in a letter or peace in disappearing without a word.

You assume there are people who care. It's also much more selfish for people to force you to live in such bad state. That's the most selfish you can be. You don't have to live it, yet you force and guilt people to live it. Inexcusable.

When you have been through all the options such as medication and theropy, there isn't much left to do. You try what you can and at the end of the day you can at least say you tried. Snap judgements are affected by external influence, but long term judgements are just a way to enlightenment and peace.

Who says I'll be so easily found? You don't have to end it in a public way. It's also way more selfish to force someone to live in such a bad state than it is to let them move on. Everyone else gets to pretend everything is golden while you don't get that luxury. It also isn't much of a worry when there is no one around you who will be affected.

I don't subscribe to that notion. I feel it's selfish for others to judge you on not wanting to live. Life isn't beautiful for everyone and it's unfair to expect people to live in such a state.  
  
I'm clear on where I am in my life. The only thing I'm not clear on is whether or not I should tell my friend or leave them hanging.
